verdict.rationale: Zulip is a chat platform, so an in-chat interactive UI story is a fair question. The evidence only describes 'interactive bots that react to messages' and a send-message API. Neither documents modals, buttons, or structured message layouts, so they are an adjacent bot capability rather than the requested UI framework.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build apps with rich interactive UI inside chat — modals, buttons, and structured message layouts
